How to reach JuneGiri Farms & Rishikesh

📅 6 Oct 2026·⏱ 7 min read·By Vignesh
Home / Journal / How to reach

Getting to Rishikesh is easy. Getting to the quiet side of Rishikesh — where we are, across the river near Neelkanth — takes one extra step that most guides skip. Here's exactly how to do it, with real times and honest costs.

The quick version: nearest station is Haridwar (45 km); nearest airport is Dehradun Jolly Grant (35 km). From either, it's about a 1.5-hour drive to JuneGiri in Maral village. We arrange pickup — just send us your train/flight details on WhatsApp.

By train (the easiest way)

Haridwar Junction is your best bet — frequent trains from Delhi, including the overnight options that get you here by breakfast. From Delhi it's roughly 5–6 hours. From Haridwar, it's about 45 km (1.5 hours) to us.

  • From Delhi: Nanda Devi Express, Dehradun Shatabdi, or the AC Special — 5–6 hours to Haridwar.
  • Rishikesh / Yoganagari Rishikesh stations exist but have fewer connections — Haridwar is almost always simpler.

By flight

Dehradun's Jolly Grant Airport (DED) is about 35 km from Rishikesh, a one-hour drive, with daily flights from Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru. From the airport to JuneGiri is around 1.5 hours. If you're short on time, this is the fastest door-to-door option.

By road / self-drive

The drive up from Delhi/NCR is genuinely pleasant once you're past Haridwar. Expect 6–7 hours from Delhi (240 km) via the Dehradun expressway and NH-7. If you're driving to us specifically, head toward Neelkanth / Yamkeshwar rather than Tapovan — your map should point to Maral village. There's safe parking at the farm.

Travel options at a glance

FromModeTime to JuneGiriRough cost (per person)
DelhiTrain to Haridwar + drive~7–8 hrs total₹500–1,500 train + pickup
DelhiFlight to Dehradun + drive~3–4 hrs total₹3,000–6,000 flight + pickup
DelhiSelf-drive~6.5–7.5 hrsFuel + tolls
HaridwarTaxi / our pickup~1.5 hrsPickup (ask us)

Let us handle the last leg

The stretch from Haridwar to Maral is where people without a plan lose an hour haggling with taxis. Don't. Send us your arrival details and we'll have a trusted driver waiting — it's one less thing to think about, and it's how most of our guests arrive. Full rates and the booking flow are on the plan your stay page.

The moment you cross the river and the traffic falls away is when the holiday actually begins. That's the stretch we love.
